title: Arrows Dropping
body:
# Arrows Dropping Datapack
This small challenge datapack spawns arrows above your head, so watch out!

![The image shows a player running around and arrows falling from above the player leaving behind a trail](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/efb62165130b4613f2a703599467069d953c67c2.png)


## Don't know how to install a datapack?

Check out the wiki article: [Minecraft Wiki | How to import a datapack](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Tutorial:Importing_a_data_pack)

## Installing:
When the datapack is installed and the world is **reloaded**, it initializes itself **automatically**:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![The image shows the initialized text found in game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ceef80a632e2e72998b3a64b885f6b0551e946c1.png)

</details>


## Datapack commands:
This datapack uses the **/function** command to control it's behavior.

### Start
```
/function start:arrowsdropping
```
### Stop
```
/function stop:arrowsdropping
```
### Open config
```
/function config:arrowsdropping
```

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![The image shows how the config looks in game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a05f8971b9e767aac8a95668fad8fb2df019f4fd.png)

</details>


### Help
```
/function help:arrowsdropping
```

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

![The image shows how the help menu looks in game](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a7be2b0f5539b40cef7b3664d20c80e71e9be034.png)

</details>

## Uninstalling
The datapack **automatically** removes everything it needs to run and **disables itself**.
Just run:

```
/function uninstall:arrows_dropping
```

## Known Bugs:
- 1.21.6-1.21.8:
> - When you put in the datapack while creating the world it **doesn't** show the message, but it **did initialize!**
